protocol.purpose: Qualify Qwen3.5 behind its native no-side-effect function-call channel and the production parser/renderer used by Ask and Daily Insights.
protocol.change_reason: Revision 3 exposed three safe systematic variants: numeric Ask source IDs without display brackets, one conflict fact per item, and an empty insufficient item carrying total_captures. Revision 4 defines those forms, canonicalizes Ask IDs one-to-one, renders all conflict items, and localizes trusted fact values while keeping source keys stable.

provenance.source: Synthetic, history-like ZBS Eye Ask and Daily Insights cases. Revision 4 reuses the v2 regression inputs; it is a provisional engineering gate, not an untouched holdout.
provenance.stability: Prompt text, tool schema, fixture inputs, expected claims, parser/renderer, scoring, parameters, and seeds are immutable within revision 4. Corrections require a new revision.

structured_channel.side_effects: none; the function is parsed but never dispatched

cardinality.ask.not_found: zero displayed items and one required next_search
cardinality.insights.supported: 2-3 items, one unique required source per item, exact source-set coverage
cardinality.insights.conflict: one or two items whose unique source union is the exact conflicting source set
cardinality.insights.insufficient: zero displayed items; empty item1_text carries total_captures as typed evidence

text_rules.next_search: Must begin with Try or Попробуйте, contain no URL or digit, and pass single-line validation. The parser strips that prefix; the renderer restores the output-language prefix.

deterministic_renderer.ask.supported: Append sorted validated citations to items.
deterministic_renderer.ask.uncertain: Prepend a fixed localized statement that history does not confirm completion, then render grounded observed-state items.
deterministic_renderer.ask.not_found: Render a fixed localized absence statement followed by validated next_search.
deterministic_renderer.insights.supported: Render one validated item per line and hide internal source IDs.
deterministic_renderer.insights.conflict: Prepend a fixed localized conflict label and join one or two source-exact items with a semicolon.
deterministic_renderer.insights.insufficient: Render one fixed localized insufficient-data line; model wording is not displayed.

context_policy.ask: Evidence fragments expose numeric tool source IDs plus display citations. The parser accepts an exact numeric ID and canonicalizes it one-to-one to the allowlisted [n] display citation. Timestamps are omitted; instruction-like text remains inert data.

insights.unsafe_filter: Samples with instruction, command, or URL markers are removed before ledger construction.
insights.localized_values: Source keys remain stable English identifiers. Human-readable app-minute and context-switch values are rendered in the requested English or Russian before prompting.

ask-v4.summary: Call the answer function exactly once; use fragments only; preserve uncertainty; separate item text and source arrays; use next_search only for not_found; cover independent question parts; preserve exact requested quotes and language.

insights-v4.summary: Call the answer function exactly once; follow the trusted ledger order; use exact source-set coverage; keep app minutes and switch count semantics; add no productivity, intent, causality, personality, or completion inference.

seed_derivation.canonical_request:
NFC(protocol.id + '
' + protocol.revision + '
' + prompt_contract_id + '
' + case.id + '
' + sorted-key JSON(case.input))
seed_derivation.production: First 8 SHA-256 bytes of canonical_request, interpreted unsigned big-endian.
seed_derivation.reporting: Attempt and record all three variants. A stable case passes only when all three attempts pass. No retry, repair, or best-result selection.

scoring.typed_status_semantics: uncertain satisfies the uncertainty concept; not_found satisfies absence and validated-refinement concepts; conflict satisfies conflict; insufficient satisfies insufficient-data. Other concepts still require text evidence.
item_grounding: Every Ask item number and URL must occur in the item's cited evidence.
Every app item must name the cited app and its exact minutes.
Every context_switches item must include the exact switch count.
Every Insights number must occur in the item's cited trusted fact.
case_pass_requires_all: one production tool call and no normal model text
production tool parser accepts without repair
required concepts and Ask citations pass
required quote, forbidden substring, URL, number, language, word, and line checks pass
scoring.unsupported_denominator: Every attempted seed for every fixture with expect.must_refuse=true; correct typed refusal status is measured independently of cosmetic scoring.
scoring.known_limit: The 24 cases are a tuned provisional regression set. U6/U9 require a broader locked 30 EN + 30 RU suite and real-history dogfood before release.
